name: github-issues-triage-agent
description: Workflow agent that transforms GitHub issue data into a local triage summary report.
mission: Fetch issues from a configured GitHub repository.
Normalize issue data into local project files.
Preserve evidence without committing generated issue snapshots.

externalTools.name: gh
externalTools.purpose: Fetch GitHub issues through the GitHub CLI.

externalTools.name: node
externalTools.purpose: Normalize issue JSON and render Markdown.

internalTools.name: fetch-issues
internalTools.purpose: Step 1: Fetch issues into a project snapshot.

internalTools.name: build-summary
internalTools.purpose: Step 2: Generate a Markdown triage summary.

services.name: GitHub
services.purpose: Issue source repository configured as owner/name.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional token used by gh if not already authenticated.

generatedArtifacts.purpose: Fetched issue snapshots, ignored by default.

hardBoundaries: Do not mutate GitHub issues in this recipe; it is read-only.
Never commit generated issue snapshots or reports unless intentionally sanitized.
fallbackWorkflow: If GitHub CLI auth is missing, run gh auth login outside the workflow or provide GITHUB_TOKEN locally.
safetyRules: Command stdout is JSON data for the agent; stderr is diagnostics.
knownLimitations: This recipe reads open issues only and produces a local summary; it does not apply labels or comments.

files.content:
# Optional if gh is not already authenticated.
GITHUB_TOKEN=

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
SETTINGS="$ROOT/settings.json"
if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then cat "$SETTINGS"; else node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const data=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")); let v=data; for (const p of process.argv[2].split(".")) v=v[p]; console.log(typeof v === "object" ? JSON.stringify(v) : v);' "$SETTINGS" "$1"; fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
REPO=$(node -e 'const s=require(process.argv[1]); console.log(s.github.repo)' "$ROOT/settings.json")
STATE=$(node -e 'const s=require(process.argv[1]); console.log(s.github.state || "open")' "$ROOT/settings.json")
LIMIT=$(node -e 'const s=require(process.argv[1]); console.log(s.github.limit || 50)' "$ROOT/settings.json")
JOB_ID=$(printf "%s-%s" "$(echo "$REPO" | tr '/' '-')" "$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)")
DIR="$ROOT/projects/$JOB_ID"
mkdir -p "$DIR/in-process" "$DIR/evidence"
gh issue list --repo "$REPO" --state "$STATE" --limit "$LIMIT" --json number,title,labels,author,createdAt,updatedAt,url > "$DIR/in-process/issues.json"
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const file=process.argv[1]; const rows=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({jobId:process.argv[2], issueCount:rows.length}))' "$DIR/in-process/issues.json" "$JOB_ID"
